actions.label: launch folds Backlog and seats the cursor on its header, so open it
then step onto the first task, which a singleton group draws in place of its heading
reset to All over Active Projects
fold the groups, which seats the cursor on the summary covering the task the cursor stood on
the header footer teaches the key rather than the menu row it replaced
no fixture ships a pinned project
the shared key on a project header pins the project
the pin commits, but the Outliner draws no project pin marker: the group header reads as it did
an unpinned project beside it stays bare too
pin it again to test the header under pressure
the narrow header keeps its slug and spends no column on a pin marker
unfolding seats the cursor on a task, so the same key means the task's pin
the task moved into the Pinned lane, which only a task pin builds
fold the cursor's own group to read the project header again
the task pin leaves the project header as it was, still with no project pin marker
